name: esmfold2
description: Single-sequence (no-MSA) protein fold with ESMFold2 (ESMC-6B LM + diffusion) on Aurora XPU; one row per chain, returns mmCIF with pLDDT/pTM.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool esmfold2.fold(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). Install paths come from site.<system>.json, resolved worker-side. The CLI launcher folds ONE chain (first FASTA record); a multi-record FASTA is reported as a failure. timeout_each is large because each row is a fresh process that pays the ~90s load + first-fold warm-up.
